label: D1 after a1->S1 rewarded, scaled by belief S1 good and late episode
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * np.clip(belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * (ep_trial/100)**4 ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 1) * belief
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Magnitude is driven by the previous trial being a1 -> S1 (common) rewarded: residual +0.175 vs about -0.065 for every other pattern, which are flat. Within a1 S1 r trials it grows with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (positive log-odds; belief deciles 6-9 rise from +0.02 to +0.15) and rises sharply late in the episode (trials ~85-99 reach ~1.0, modeled with (ep_trial/100)^4). On the window first trial (previous choice unknown) a rewarded D1 scaled by belief stands in. The trial before (reward at -2, streaks) and belief_cover add nothing. Observed-only test R^2 beyond timing 0.36, matching the all-observed reference (0.36) and about 86% of the all ceiling (0.42); the earlier model-based label used the D1 a1 logit (policy decile alone 0.19), so dropping model outputs loses little here. Large residual misses remain: some late a1 S1 r D1s at ~1.0 are under-predicted at ~0.47.
